notes.title: Next Update: Appearance
notes.content: Next update (not the smaller patch released today) replaces the default character model with one generated via UE5's MetaHuman.

notes.title: Added "Enhancement" abilities
notes.content:
Patch notes:

"Enhancement" abilities added to Abilities menu in the "Other" section.

[list][*]
[*]"Enhancements OFF" is the default.
[*]"Enhancements ON" increases running speed, jump height ceiling (when using jump height scaling), and throw distance.
[*] "Enhancements OVERDRIVE" enables high-speed dodging and attacking, which costs energy, which is why it's a separate setting.

NPCs do not currently react to any of these enhancements.

notes.title: Small update experimenting with combat controls
notes.content:
Patch notes:

[list]
[*]Added new instructions that appear when in combat mode ("Attack" ability) if guide is on.
[*]Use movement and camera inputs while holding attack button to perform moves.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch to fix small input problems
notes.content:
Patch notes:

[list]
[*]Pitch inversion now applies correctly to KB/M controls.
[*]Name of equipped ability is now reflected in on-screen input guide.
[*]KB/M controls for Abilities Menu selection now implemented.
[/list]

notes.title: User experience update: on-screen input guide
notes.content: Players now have an on-screen input guide that changes dynamically with the current control context.

notes.title: UI update
notes.content: UI icon style (e.g. Xbox, PS4, Mouse & Keyboard) can now be changed in the options menu.
